text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — Service: inference-runtime-prod — Trigger: error-rate > 5% (5m). Incident PD-4872 fired. Escalation policy: primary-oncall -> secondary -> manager.

incident-bot: incident created: PD-4872 · inference-runtime-prod · urgent
• Affected: API 10.0.x cluster (us-west-2)
• Symptoms: 5xx spike, request timeouts, some streams failing mid-response
• Check /status on hosts and autoscaling groups

oncall-anna: acked PD-4872 :white_check_mark:
I'm looking now — pulling live tail and dashboards.

oncall-anna: quick note: paging policy will escalate to secondary in 2m if I don't confirm ownership of mitigation steps.

sre-miguel: i can join — running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide` to see pod restarts

sre-miguel: logs show repeated OOMKill on runtime-worker-3 and slow KV cache misses. stacktrace includes lots of `OutOfMemoryError` in tensor allocations.

oncall-anna: trying to spin a hotfix patch — increasing container memory request on the worst nodes and temporarily reducing batch size. will post commands.

oncall-anna: deploying quick patch:
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-runtime -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"12Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"12Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```
Scaling replica to 6 while we validate: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime -n inference --replicas=6`

pagerduty-bot: Secondary on-call (oncall-jay) did not acknowledge within 2m — escalating to manager (manager-helen).

oncall-jay: receiving page now, trying mobile — ringing... (can't ack from mobile due to poor reception).

oncall-anna: heads up, if secondary is unreachable we'll need manager-level approval to extend autoscaling beyond quota. manager-helen, pinging you.

manager-helen: on call page received, will approve emergency quota bump if needed. can someone confirm customer impact?

ps-lee: CS: we have 3 customers reporting degraded completions (timeouts) and one internal monitoring alert from large-customer-qa. Not widespread yet but visible for high-concurrency workloads.

eng-sara: adding temporary route fallback: route requests for customers in PRODUCTION tier to smaller model variant (ram-friendly) to reduce pressure. updating router rules now.

eng-sara: router change (canary) applied to 5% of traffic. monitor for error-rate improvement.

oncall-anna: after patch + scale, 5xx rate dropped from 7.3% -> 3.1% at edge, p50 latency slightly up but stable. still seeing pod OOMs on two nodes.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty escalation: manager-helen acknowledged escalation for PD-4872. :rotating_light:

oncall-jay: finally got cell service, acked PD-4872. will join remote session in 4 mins. apologies for delay.

sre-miguel: next actions: drain affected nodes, force new scheduling, verify KV cache warmup. command I ran:
```
kubectl drain ip-10-0-34-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-34-12
```
Then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n inference`

oncall-anna: documenting timeline for postmortem. key timeline notes saved to incident doc: temporary model routing, memory bump, replica scale, node drain.

ps-lee: notifying impacted customers with status update: short message sent, we say investigating root cause and applying mitigations, ETA 30m for stabilization.

manager-helen: thanks team. log of escalation: secondary didn't pick up in window -> manager was paged -> manager approved emergency quota. Good triage. Please include why secondary missed ack in postmortem (phone DND or notification failure).

oncall-jay: FYI my phone was on DND due to travel — will change PD mobile policy. sorry.

sre-miguel: current status: error-rate down to 1.2% edge-wide, rollback of temporary routing planned after 1h steady-state. resources currently stable.

eng-sara: leaving a note: quick follow-ups — add health-check more granular for memory pressure, add PD escalation fallback to SMS if mobile app unacked, and add runbook step for reducing batch size automatically on OOM signals.

incident-bot: incident PD-4872 updated: status = monitoring; participants: oncall-anna, oncall-jay, sre-miguel, eng-sara, ps-lee, manager-helen.

oncall-anna: closing thread here, will open postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
